_doc: Board points, one per submitted version: version, board_s, local_20m_median_s and instructions_per_row (make eval-calibrate fills missing local values from results). Wall model: one point = ratio, two or more = linear fit. Instruction model: board = fixed_s + instructions_per_row x board_rows / rate; one point fixes rate with fixed_s = fixed_prior_s, two or more fit both.
